title: Fall back to built-in TUI fuzzy picker when fzf isn't installed
description:
`try promote` currently hard-requires fzf for both source-selection and
destination-selection. If fzf isn't on PATH, the command errors out with:

    fzf not found on PATH — install it (`brew install fzf`) or pass a destination flag

The repo already has a battle-tested fuzzy matcher (`internal/fuzzy`,
98.3% coverage) and a Bubble Tea TUI (`internal/tui`) that uses it. We
should reuse those as a fallback so promote works out-of-the-box.

## Acceptance criteria

- When config has `[promote].picker = "fzf"` (the default) and fzf IS on
  PATH → keep current behavior (shell out to fzf).
- When fzf is NOT on PATH → fall back to the built-in Bubble Tea picker
  with the existing fuzzy matcher. No error, no install nag.
- Add `picker = "builtin"` config value to force the built-in picker
  even when fzf is installed.
- Both source-selection (which try to promote) and destination-selection
  (which dir under promote.root) need to use the fallback.
- Source picker should look ~ like the existing `try exec` TUI — list
  entries with date prefix + display name, fuzzy filter on type.
- Destination picker shows relative paths under promote.root.
- ESC / Ctrl-C cancels cleanly (same "cancelled" error path as fzf
  exit-130).
- Update `runPicker` in `internal/promote/promote.go` so callers don't
  need to know which picker won — they just pass labels and get a
  selection.

## Design notes

The existing TUI is wired specifically to `tries.Manager` (it lets you
create/rename/delete entries in addition to selecting one). The promote
flow doesn't want any of that — it just wants "pick one from this list."

Options:
  1. Add a generic single-select Bubble Tea model in a new package
     (e.g. `internal/picker`) that takes `[]string` + prompt and returns
     a selection. Reuse `internal/fuzzy` for filtering. Cleanest.
  2. Extend the existing tui model with a "select-only" mode. Risk of
     coupling promote logic to tries-list-display concerns.

Lean toward option 1.

## Files likely touched

- `internal/picker/picker.go` (new) — single-select Bubble Tea model
- `internal/picker/picker_test.go` (new)
- `internal/promote/promote.go` — `runPicker` dispatches: try fzf if
  configured-and-available; else fall through to builtin
- `internal/config/config.go` — accept `picker = "builtin"` (already
  accepts "fzf"); the existing fzf-only validation in promote.go needs
  to allow "builtin" too
- Update CLAUDE.md / docs in promote.go to describe the fallback
